name: Office Use and Indoor Topology
constraints: Office is an effective-dated use designation of a premises or bounded premises set.
Indoor navigation and topology are WM-BLT-002 profiles rather than competing spatial identity.
Address, occupier, room number and use designation never define premises identity.
Re-parenting preserves spatial-unit identity; split or merge creates explicit lineage.
Lease, ownership, legal branch, access, booking and person identity remain external.

indoorTopology.retargeting: Every inbound WM-PLC-009 relation must be inventoried and retargeted before retirement.

compositionConstraints: Gazetteer Place locates Site by reference and never contains it.
Facility may exist without Site, and Building may exist without Facility.
Optional intermediate layers never change Premises identity.
